name: Saving Throw Advantage
description: Grants advantage on saving throws against a category of effects or sources.

mechanics.text: While active, grants advantage on saving throws against whatever this record's own featureParams.against names (a spell, a category of magic, a specific threat, ...). Cost tier is keyed to how BROAD that category is — advantage against one specific poison is worth far less than advantage against spells generally, and a flat cost couldn't say so.
Only relevant in one already-triggered scenario — e.g. a new save against an effect the target is already suffering from, not a standing defense.
Against one specific hazard or damage source — a poison, a named gas/vapor, a single spell.
Against a whole creature type's own signature abilities — e.g. a dragon's Frightful Presence and breath weapon together.
Against spells and magical effects generally — a sweeping, standing defense against nearly all hostile magic.
